tool.name: StringTie merge
tool.command: stringtie --merge ## --merge transcript ordering/IDs are non-deterministic with multiple threads; pin to 1 for reproducible output -p 1 #if $guide_gff: -G '$guide_gff' #end if -m $min_len -c $min_cov -F $min_fpkm -T $min_tpm -f $min_iso -g $gap_len $keep_introns #set inputs = "' '".join(str($input_gtf).split(',')) -o '$out_gtf' '$inputs'

param.name: guide_gff
param.label: Reference annotation to include in the merging

param.name: min_len
param.label: Minimum input transcript length to include in the merge
param.help: Input transcripts shorter than this are not included in the merge.

param.name: min_cov
param.label: Minimum input transcript coverage to include in the merge
param.help: Input transcripts with a lower per-base coverage are not included in the merge. May be fractional; 0 disables this filter.

param.name: min_fpkm
param.label: Minimum input transcript FPKM to include in the merge
param.help: Input transcripts with a lower FPKM are not included in the merge.

param.name: min_tpm
param.label: Minimum input transcript TPM to include in the merge
param.help: Input transcripts with a lower TPM are not included in the merge.

param.name: min_iso
param.label: Minimum isoform fraction
param.help: Minimum isoform abundance of the merged transcripts, as a fraction of the most abundant transcript assembled at a given locus.

validator.message: The minimum isoform fraction must be less than 1.

param.name: gap_len
param.label: Gap between transcripts to merge together
param.help: Transcripts that are closer than this distance are merged together in the same locus.

param.name: keep_introns
param.label: Keep merged transcripts with retained introns
param.help: By default these are not kept unless there is strong evidence for them

tool.help:
**What it does?**
This is a special usage mode of StringTie_, distinct from the assembly usage mode. In the merge mode, StringTie takes as input a list of GTF/GFF files and merges/assembles these transcripts into a non-redundant set of transcripts. This mode is used in the new differential analysis pipeline to generate a global, unified set of transcripts (isoforms) across multiple RNA-Seq samples.
The thresholds on this form follow StringTie's merge mode defaults: a minimum input transcript length of 50 bp, no minimum input coverage (0), a minimum FPKM and TPM of 1, a minimum isoform fraction of 0.01 and a 250 bp gap between transcripts to merge. Note that merge mode does not apply the 0.001 lower bound that assembly mode enforces on ``-c``, which is why the coverage filter can be set to 0 here.
If a reference annotation is provided, StringTie will assemble the transfrags from the input GTF files with the reference transcripts.
.. _StringTie: http://ccb.jhu.edu/software/stringtie/
